facts.fact: Expertise France's project page says a technical assistance project, running from 1 January 2022 to 15 September 2024 (status ended), supports the national agency ASSI in setting up Benin's open data initiative, with a first axis of putting in place an open data regulation; it reports no adopted policy.

The World Bank open data readiness assessment, written for the Government of Benin, says the draft access to information bill and its Open Data decree were under discussion within the government, with no clear date for sending them to parliament and little progress in over 12 months; it names adoption of the bill and decree as the first priority.

facts.fact: The assessment says the national open data portal, built on CKAN and developed by the digital agency ASIN in 2021, was being finalised and was due to be officially launched in 2023; it reports no data published on it and says no open data licence or law yet exists.
